changelog: v0.4.1: Migrated from WebLLM/WebGPU to unified CPU WebAssembly (WASM): 1) Replaced WebLLM and WebGPU shaders with Transformers.js ONNX Runtime CPU WASM; 2) Added SmolLM2 135M as default ultra-lightweight model (~80 MB, ~15-20 tok/s on CPU); 3) Preserved Qwen 2.5 0.5B in quantized CPU WASM format (~350 MB); 4) Universal out-of-the-box compatibility on Meta Quest 3, mobile, and desktop without chrome://flags; 5) Shared ONNX runtime caching between Whisper STT, Neural TTS, and SmolLM/Qwen text generation.
